plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/current/execution.js:395-404 and :465-471
In-memory reproduction using the pinned implementation: completeJournalSelection=FAIL; afterTerminalFailureEventLoss=PASS; newerRetainedJobOutcome=FAIL; remainingLatestJob=false.
Separate project() reproduction: pausedWithTerminalEvent=true; pausedAfterTerminalEventLoss=false.
These were read-only in-memory reproductions and source tracing, not filesystem fault-injection or a hosted merge execution.
priorFindings.invariant: f1 — undetected journal suffix loss restores obsolete eligibility. the reader accepts any surviving contiguous hash-chain prefix. after a newer failed job_finished event disappears, projection omits its result, historygaps finds no missing reference, and current-result selection can accept an older pass despite a retained newer failed job. losing a terminal paused event similarly removes the stop without human continuation. the savejob-before-job_finished crash window also leaves retained outcomes unreconciled until execution retry. shared milestone and merge checks inherit this state error.

priorFindings.summary: F1 — Previously passing retention evidence can authorize completion after required failed-specification evidence is lost or corrupted.
evidence: Reachable sequence: retain a failed spec-validation record; correct and validate the spec; complete the other obligations and obtain retention PASS; then lose or corrupt the failed validation's proof or uniquely retained input documents.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/current/execution.js:583 checks state.validationFailures during execution, but the result returned at line 585 does not bind those references into its retained closure.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/current/core.js:547 reports the resulting loss as gate spec-validation with position -1. The barrier at line 330 does not invalidate retention, and currentResult returns the old PASS.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/current/core.js:493 and line 504 admit that result and mark retention satisfied. If the other completion conditions remain satisfied, missing failed-validation evidence does not block completion.

A filesystem-free in-memory probe exercised the actual currentResult, historyGaps and CurrentStore.closure implementations: retention returned PASS before deletion; after deletion, historyGaps reported the missing spec-validation proof and retention still returned PASS.
cli/test/current-core.test.js:1372 tests a fresh retention execution after loss, rather than admission of an existing retention PASS after loss.

This affects R1, R6, R7 and R11. It applies to missing or corrupt failed-validation diagnostics and failed-input references; a later failure added after an earlier retention run is likewise outside that run's bound closure.
priorFindings.invariant: f1 — previously passing retention evidence can authorize completion after required failed-specification evidence is lost or corrupted.

priorFindings.summary: Milestone passage can be recorded for a candidate that was never checked.
evidence: current/core.js:349-357 checks one state, reloads another, and appends using the newer event count and candidate.
A concurrent candidate.prepare can replace A with broader, unready B while A's eligibility check completes.
The read-only probe appended acceptance for B with ready=false. This violates R1, R4, and R17.
priorFindings.invariant: milestone passage can be recorded for a candidate that was never checked.

priorFindings.summary: Merge execution can use superseded action authority and attribute integration to a different candidate.
evidence: current/actions.js:49-55 captures A's exact authorization before the hosted-check wait.
The later check at :71 establishes eligibility of whatever candidate is current, without checking that its authority still names the captured action.
A dependency-injected probe switched current authority to B/squash during waiting; the adapter issued A's --merge and returned integration for B. This violates R16 and R17.
priorFindings.invariant: merge execution can use superseded action authority and attribute integration to a different candidate.

priorFindings.summary: An applicable review that closes a finding misses reuse on the next equivalent request.
evidence: current/execution.js:303-310 correctly omits equivalent closed history, but :371-373 requires that new list to equal the closing review's original history.
The read-only probe confirmed currentResult accepted the closing PASS, yet executeGates proceeded to JOB_STARTED.

Repeating a claim for the same retained finding instead failed at :332 with 'Disposition claim lacks a retained finding' because its report had been omitted automatically. This is a related R10 scenario.
priorFindings.invariant: an applicable review that closes a finding misses reuse on the next equivalent request.

priorFindings.summary: Semantically identical repository and grouped-gate selections have order-sensitive evidence identities.

current/execution.js:59 preserves requested gate order in reviewContract, and :372 uses that contract in reuse selection.

priorFindings.invariant: semantically identical repository and grouped-gate selections have order-sensitive evidence identities.

priorFindings.summary: R8: required local evaluator execution evidence is not inspectable in the supplied bundle.
evidence: The rubric requires provider contract tests and a retained local evaluator execution receipt: docs/issues/tb-multirepo-review-input/spec.md:252.
